metaTitle: OUTSIDE — See your company from the outside
metaDescription: Evidence-first external attack surface management: passive discovery, verified assessments, continuous Guardian monitoring, BYOK intelligence, and reversible remediation.
notFoundTitle: This asset is outside our view.
notFoundBody: The page you were looking for does not exist. Head back and map an external surface instead.
openGraphBody: Map your publicly observable digital footprint and reveal forgotten, unexpected, and changing external assets.
emailVerifiedComplete: Email verified — your workspace is fully unlocked.
intelligenceAfterCorrelation: Findings, evidence and posture appear only after deterministic observations are correlated.
assetInspectionHint: Routing, technology, confidence, signals and source evidence stay one click from the graph.
storySeedDetail: northstarlabs.example becomes the deterministic root entity.
storyDiscoverDetail: Certificate transparency and DNS agree on six public hostnames.
storyClassifyDetail: A public hostname and verified HTTPS response support a login-surface classification.
storyChangeDetail: Historical identity links the hostname to an asset absent from the last scan.
storyExplainDetail: The finding is prioritized with provenance, impact and a review—not a fabricated vulnerability.
captureTitle: Capture the selected browser surface as PNG
ownershipConfirmed: Ownership of {domain} is confirmed. Monitoring and deeper inspection are unlocked.
serveVerificationValue: Serve the same value at {path}. Either method verifies ownership.
passiveWithoutVerification: Passive external view works without verification.
txtNotFound: TXT record not found yet. DNS can take a few minutes — try again shortly.
verificationInstructions: Add the DNS TXT record below, then check verification after it has propagated.
clipboardDenied: Clipboard access was denied. Select and copy the TXT value manually.
animatedGraphSummary: Animated asset graph showing {visible} of {total} currently revealed public assets.
sharedCtaBody: Run a free passive scan of any domain, then monitor it continuously — OUTSIDE alerts you when your public exposure changes.
sharedExpiredBody: Shared reports are available for 30 days. Run a fresh scan to see the current picture.
sharedMethodology: Generated from passive, public sources only (Certificate Transparency, DNS). Findings separate observed facts from inference and are prioritized items to review, never confirmed exploitation.
reportDeterministicNote: Every statement is generated from the current deterministic scan result. Demo datasets remain visibly watermarked.
workflowUpdateFailed: The workflow update could not be saved. The previous status was restored.
postureNoActions: No protection actions are outstanding — the observable surface is well contained.

postureImprovementSummary.one: Resolving {count} open recommendation would improve your protection posture from {current} to {potential} (+{gain}).
postureImprovementSummary.other: Resolving {count} open recommendations would improve your protection posture from {current} to {potential} (+{gain}).

liveChangeWarning: These steps change live infrastructure — review them before you roll them out. OUTSIDE does not apply them for you.
impactedIfCompromised: Impacted if this fails or is compromised
assetOwnershipConfidence: How confident OUTSIDE is that this asset belongs to the target organization.
thirdPartyReviewTitle: Review third-party dependencies exposed through DNS
thirdPartyReviewObservation: Public DNS delegates part of the surface around {label} to an external provider.
thirdPartyReviewConcern: A compromised, abandoned or misconfigured third-party service can affect trust in your domain.
thirdPartyReviewRecommendation: Inventory third-party delegations, remove dangling DNS records and monitor each provider.
remediationReviewEvidence: Review the cited evidence and confirm the current configuration.
remediationConfirmScope: Confirm the affected asset, owner and intended public exposure.
remediationApplyControlled: Apply the change through your normal reviewed change process.
remediationVerifyMonitor: Verify the result externally and keep monitoring for regression.
remediationRollbackChange: Restore the previous reviewed configuration if verification fails.
remediationRollbackAdvisory: Advisory only; no infrastructure change is applied by OUTSIDE.
proposalValidationFailed: The proposal is outside the validated safe scope. Review it manually before use.
investigationIncidentSummary: {findings} correlated signals across {assets} assets form one reviewable exposure.
investigationCounterCdn: Part of this surface is behind a CDN or WAF, which can mitigate some of the indicated exposure.
investigationCounterAttribution: Organization attribution for {asset} is {confidence}% confident, so ownership should be confirmed.
investigationCounterInference: Some signals rely on naming or heuristics rather than confirmed configuration; a benign explanation remains possible.
investigationCounterExternal: This is external observation only: it identifies exposure to review, not confirmed misconfiguration or compromise.
investigationHypothesis: {findings} correlated signals across {assets} assets most plausibly describe one exposure led by “{lead}”.
confidenceExplanation: {value}% deterministic confidence. This expresses evidence strength, not exploitability or proof of compromise.
